components.name: Primary button

components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #1c1b19); background: var(--bg-raised, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e0d8); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { color: var(--accent, #c2410c); border-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary { min-height: 46px; justify-content: center; color: var(--bg, #fbfaf7); background: var(--text, #1c1b19); border-color: var(--text, #1c1b19); } .ds-button-primary:hover { color: var(--bg, #fbfaf7); background: var(--accent, #c2410c); border-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.65; cursor: wait; }

components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #1c1b19); max-width: 360px; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-email { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e0d8); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); color: var(--text, #1c1b19); background: var(--bg-raised, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; accent-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); caret-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-email::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary, #55524c); opacity: 1; } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-header { min-height: var(--header-height, 56px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e0d8); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg, #fbfaf7) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: var(--text, #1c1b19); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark { color: inherit; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark-suffix { color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: var(--text-secondary, #55524c); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-wordmark:hover { color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-header { gap: 8px; } .ds-nav { gap: 10px; font-size: 0.8125rem; } } @media (max-width: 360px) { .ds-wordmark { font-size: 0.875rem; } }

components.css: .ds-rating-details { max-width: 220px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-rating { --tone: var(--prefer, #067647); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tone) 30%, var(--border, #e4e0d8)); border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tone) 10%, var(--bg-raised, #ffffff)); color: var(--tone); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rating::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure { font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-rating-details[open] .ds-disclosure { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-rationale { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--text-secondary, #55524c); } .ds-rating:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-post { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; gap: 36px; padding: 36px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e0d8); color: var(--text, #1c1b19); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: var(--text-secondary, #55524c); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-category { color: var(--accent, #c2410c); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-post-title { margin: 0 0 12px; max-width: 35ch; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-title-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-post-summary { max-width: 64ch; color: var(--text-secondary, #55524c); margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-read-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: inherit; text-decoration-color: var(--muted, #8a867e); text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-title-link:hover, .ds-read-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #c2410c); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-title-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-read-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-post { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 28px 0; } .ds-meta { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; } .ds-category { margin-bottom: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Readable text, concrete code examples, and visible source links define this site. IBM Plex Sans carries explanations; IBM Plex Mono identifies code and the wordmark. Warm neutral surfaces and restrained orange accents carry the same identity in light and dark appearances.

The guide, article index, long articles, and newsletter use the same shell and controls. Reading pages may adjust headline scale, line length, and column structure to suit their content. This record describes the implemented site; it does not authorize a new brand, a redesign, or changes to captured external guides.
keyCharacteristics: Text leads, with code and source attribution close to the explanation.
Warm light and dark neutrals share one orange interaction accent.
Fine borders and spacing organize flat surfaces.
Forms use visible labels, native controls, and direct status text.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: New reading surfaces use the shared CSS variables so their text, borders, controls, and interaction states follow both appearances together.

rules.name: The Two Fonts Rule
rules.body: Keep prose in the sans family and code, technical labels, and the wordmark in the mono family.

dos: Do reuse the shared palette, font variables, buttons, and focus treatment in both color schemes.
Do keep readable line lengths and let editorial layouts collapse to a clear single reading order.
Do keep semantic labels beside their colors and visible labels beside form controls.
Do preserve source links, rule anchors, and honest wording about what the product can do.
donts: Don't add a new font, palette, shadow system, or card treatment as part of an ordinary extension.
Don't replace the guide's established heading and field variants with the blog's larger reading variants.
Don't present generated tonal-ramp previews as additional application colors.
Don't invent endorsements, subscriber counts, author credentials, or delivery capabilities.
